intro.en: Azure Language offers ready-made text analysis. Know what each technique returns.
intro.ro: Azure Language tayyar text analysis deta hai. Yaad rakhein ke har technique kya deti hai.

text.en: Returns the language name, its code and a confidence score.
text.ro: Zabaan ka naam, code aur confidence score deta hai.

text.en: Returns the main topics as a list of phrases, without opinion.
text.ro: Aham topics ki list deta hai, baghair raaye ke.

text.en: Finds people, places, organizations, dates, quantities and their categories.
text.ro: Log, jaghein, idare, tareekhein, miqdar aur un ki categories dhoondta hai.

text.en: Finds personal data and can return the text with it masked.
text.ro: Zaati data dhoondta hai aur usay chhupa kar text de sakta hai.

text.en: Labels documents and sentences positive, neutral, negative or mixed with scores.
text.ro: Documents aur jumlon ko positive, neutral, negative ya mixed label aur scores deta hai.

text.en: Links an opinion to its target, such as breakfast → terrible.
text.ro: Raaye ko us ke target se jorta hai, jaise breakfast → terrible.

text.en: Extractive picks existing sentences; abstractive writes new ones.
text.ro: Extractive maujooda jumlay chunta hai; abstractive naye jumlay likhta hai.

text.en: Tokenize, normalize, remove stop words, build n-grams, stem (cut endings) or lemmatize (dictionary form).
text.ro: Tokenize, normalize, stop words nikalna, n-grams, stem (aakhri hissa kaatna) ya lemmatize (dictionary shakal).

text.en: TF-IDF finds the special terms of a document, bag-of-words counts words for a classifier, TextRank ranks sentences in a graph.
text.ro: TF-IDF document ki khaas terms dhoondta hai, bag-of-words classifier ke liye alfaaz ginta hai, TextRank graph mein jumlay rank karta hai.

text.en: Embeddings place words with similar meaning close together; cosine similarity measures it.
text.ro: Embeddings milte matlab wale alfaaz qareeb rakhte hain; cosine similarity naapti hai.

text.en: "The staff in Lahore was great, but the room was cold." Language: English. Key phrases: staff, Lahore, room. Entity: Lahore (location). Sentiment: mixed. Opinions: staff → great, room → cold.
text.ro: "The staff in Lahore was great, but the room was cold." Zabaan: English. Key phrases: staff, Lahore, room. Entity: Lahore (location). Sentiment: mixed. Opinions: staff → great, room → cold.

rows.en: Route messages to the right language team
rows.ro: Messages sahi zabaan ki team ko bhejna

rows.en: Find customer names, cities and dates
rows.ro: Customers ke naam, sheher aur tareekhein
Share karne se pehle phone numbers chhupana
Majmooi tor par khush ya nakhush

rows.en: What exactly they like or dislike
rows.ro: Asal mein kya pasand ya napasand hai

rows.en: Short version in the original sentences

remember.en: Scores are confidence values between 0 and 1, not a grade of the text.
remember.ro: Scores 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan confidence hain, text ke number nahi.

remember.en: Mixed sentiment exists for documents with positive and negative sentences.
remember.ro: Mixed sentiment un documents ka hota hai jin mein positive aur negative jumlay hon.

remember.en: PII detection is a special kind of entity recognition.
remember.ro: PII detection entity recognition ki khaas qism hai.

remember.en: A chat model can do the same, but with less consistent output and no built-in scores.
remember.ro: Chat model bhi ye kar sakta hai, lekin output kam yaksan aur score ke baghair hota hai.

remember.en: A term that is in every document has a TF-IDF of 0.
remember.ro: Jo term har document mein ho us ka TF-IDF 0 hai.

traps.en: Key phrases do not tell you whether people like something.
traps.ro: Key phrases ye nahi batate ke logon ko cheez pasand hai ya nahi.

traps.en: Translation is a separate service and not part of these techniques.
traps.ro: Translation alag service hai, in techniques ka hissa nahi.

traps.en: Stemming may leave a form that is no word; lemmatization returns a real word.
traps.ro: Stemming aisi shakal chhor sakti hai jo lafz nahi; lemmatization asal lafz deti hai.
